about: TEST DUMMY's place in the score (Engine 2 E5, Task 5): a roster entry in the same format as data/roster.json, read by bf_content::fighters2::cfg and never appended to the roster (the dummy stays hidden). It plays MARIMBA's voice in MARIMBA's register; its abilities name its own moves (unlock1 and unlock2 its two Special moves, low its Low move). Its weapon and ability kinds are Engine 2's, so the current engine loads them as not ported.
